scope: cold-free-electron KN kernel and cosmological first collision, actual Be7 source weighted; no product code or full cascade

inputs.normalization: N0=nb0*YBe7; nuclear gamma count=N0*0.104*DeltaF from raw cumulative F

constants.policy: CODATA2022 recommended central electron constants, not physically exact; c,kB,eV conversion exact

kernel.thermal_model: free stationary electrons; report theta_e,kBT/E; no thermal accuracy guarantee from numerical tolerance

numerics.source_quadrature: equal-F midpoint; raw weight DeltaF/n; monotone PL-F inverse handles plateaus
numerics.first_collision_integral: integrate exp(-tau)*observable(E(u(tau))) using >=64 point quadrature, with refinement or independent consistency checks
avoid: uniform cosmological z grid for unresolved first mean free path
unlabeled first-event energies as common-epoch densities

required_summary: first-collision z/u quantiles and pre-collision redshift loss at source quantiles
tau_end,no-collision survival or its log,probability and energy truncation bounds
source-weighted electron kinetic yield,remaining photon energy at first event,prior cosmological loss
yield per gamma,per initial donor,per baryon,per present comoving cm^3; actual source count
all convergence/independent residuals and measured total numerical wall time
prepared multiple-scattering + electron-cooling algorithm from theory; no simulated heat or full cascade

high_x.method: closed formula, not underresolved fixed angular quadrature

acceptance.positivity: all cross sections, probabilities,kinetic yields nonnegative; no silent clipping

Wolfram_reuse.comparison: evaluate same rounded x or allow <=1e-8 relative for declared constant rounding difference

next_action_on_pass: independent scientific review, then use KN kernel as concrete transport and electron-cooling handoff
failure_action: return substantive discrepancy for one targeted theory-authorized repair; preserve raw outputs and budget debit
